query: DELETE FROM recipients AS r WHERE r.account_id = $1 AND r.envelope_id = $2 AND NOT (r.id = ANY($3)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recipient_tokens t WHERE t.account_id = r.account_id AND t.recipient_id = r.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recipients o WHERE o.account_id = r.account_id AND o.reassigned_to = r.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fields f WHERE f.account_id = r.account_id AND f.recipient_id = r.id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM signature_adoptions s WHERE s.account_id = r.account_id AND s.recipient_id = r.id)
